audit.report: A card_settlement job (pid 993282, class PROTECTED_SETTLEMENT) went idle in transaction for 4.2 seconds with last statement SELECT 1, blocking checkout sessions. Checkout success dropped to 30% over 30 seconds with $12,964/min revenue at risk. The Database Guardian investigated and confirmed the job is non-replayable with a never_interrupt policy; terminating it risked double charges or lost settlements. The trade-off analysis showed waiting ~41 seconds would cost ~$8,815 and fit within the 60-second degradation tolerance. Both guardians agreed to wait in a single round. The blocker finished on its own immediately (0s wait), and verification confirmed full recovery: 100% checkout success over 10 seconds, no lock waits, and no protected operations aborted.
audit.root_cause: A card_settlement job (protected_settlement, non-replayable, never_interrupt policy) entered an idle-in-transaction state with last statement SELECT 1, blocking checkout sessions for 4.2 seconds before completing on its own.
lessons: card_settlement workload: add monitoring and alerting for 'idle in transaction' state exceeding a short threshold (e.g., 5s) since this workload is never_interrupt and non-replayable, making early detection critical.

card_settlement workload: investigate why the job goes idle with 'SELECT 1' as its last statement — this pattern suggests an application-level bug or external dependency hang rather than database work.

protected_settlement jobs: the trade-off calculator estimated 41s remaining runtime but actual wait was 0s; instrument these jobs with real-time progress heartbeats to improve wait/terminate decisions.
audit.negotiation_critique: The Database Guardian conducted thorough evidence gathering (4 probes) before proposing, and both guardians aligned on the BIZ-5 trade-off analysis; the negotiation concluded correctly in one round with no wasted rounds, missed evidence, or invariant overrides.
follow_ups: Root cause analysis: determine why the card_settlement job entered idle-in-transaction with SELECT 1 (application bug, external API hang, connection pool issue?).
Add real-time progress monitoring/heartbeats for protected_settlement jobs to replace static runtime estimates with actual progress.
Review the 60-second degradation tolerance against the $18,400/min revenue run-rate to confirm the risk appetite is still appropriate.
